description: Pins the repo's PRIMARY worktree to its default branch: BLOCKS a `git commit`/`cherry-pick`/`merge`/`rebase`/`revert`/`am` on the default branch of the primary checkout (agents must commit in their own worktree; `merge --ff-only`, `--abort`/`--quit`, `commit --dry-run` stay allowed) and a `git checkout`/`git switch` that would move the primary checkout (never a `git worktree add` linked worktree) onto anything but the default branch. Complements worktree-only-writes, which blocks the Edit/Write but never sees the checkout itself, and — once on a feature branch — wrongly treats that as 'exactly where authoring belongs' regardless of WHICH worktree it is. ON BY DEFAULT where a rig.yaml exists: shares the worktree-only-writes.worktree_only knob (env RIG_WORKTREE_ONLY=0 or rig.yaml agent_hooks.worktree_only:false opts out). Deny-by-default: no env-var/inline self-service bypass (removed, Alex tg#6554); RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_PIN_PRIMARY_WORKTREE with a written justification asks Telegram via trusted tg-ctl before the additive repo-owner agent_hooks.approval_cmd fallback. Every checkout/switch segment in a CHAINED command is gated (approving one never waves a later one through), so a single invocation can call approval_cmd/the hatch escalation more than once; an internal 10s AGGREGATE budget across the whole chain (see pin_primary_worktree._MAIN_LOOP_BUDGET_S) denies any segment left unchecked once that budget is spent, keeping total runtime comfortably under this descriptor's timeout even with multiple gate-worthy segments. timeout_ms 960000 STRICTLY EXCEEDS the helper's 930s worst case (tg-ctl ask's 900s cap plus a 30s cleanup margin) by a 30s headroom. This is a SAFETY margin, not cosmetic: this hook is on_error=open, so if the helper's worst case merely EQUALLED the descriptor budget, a hung/unanswered tg-ctl could race the bridge's descriptor-timeout kill into a SILENT ALLOW instead of the helper's intended deny. The headroom guarantees the helper emits its own deny first. Claude Code settings entries that launch cc_hook_bridge must also set timeout >960s; the CC command-hook default is 600s and will preempt this descriptor. on_error=open: a git/parse failure fails open (allows). Alex tg#6462/tg#6477.
